limitations: No vhci_hcd/usbip_core or /lib/modules in this environment; OS enumeration, HP driver binding and Conn3x are unverified.
The generated-guest browser test uses a local secure origin; public HTTPS-origin Local Network Access permission UI is not covered.
A permanently lost session-creation reply or one exceeding its eight-second deadline leaves an unknown identity to expire under the 35-second server lease.
Original HP48gII/HP49g+ GET_CONFIGURATION NAK is retained; descriptor/configuration and bulk results are recorded separately.
